subject: rstan and RStudio on linux with an R installation using subarchitectures

messages.author: 6cd426f33f0a8492
messages.subject: rstan and RStudio on linux with an R installation using subarchitectures
parts:
G'day all,

As indicated in my last posting, on my linux machine (Ubuntu 14.04.1 LTS), I compile R from source and install both a 32 bit version and a 64 bit version; both as subarchitectures.  To my surprise, I noticed that I cannot run stan() from the rstan package on my machine when I use RStudio. The error message I receive is:

    Error in get_makefile_txt() :
       file /opt/R/R-3.3.2/lib/R/etc//Makeconf does not exist

As indicated in the error message, the problem seems to be in the function get_make_file_text() in R/makefile_op.R in the rstan source.  The code in function tries to find the architecture via the following command:

    rarch <- Sys.getenv("R_ARCH") # unix only

If I start R from a command shell, then:

R> Sys.getenv("R_ARCH")
[1] "/64"

However, if I use RStudio, then:

RStudio> Sys.getenv("R_ARCH")
[1] ""

On the other hand, the function makeconf_path(), defined in R/misc.R of the rstan source, works perfectly under RStudio:

RStudio> makeconf_path()
[1] "/opt/R/R-3.3.2/lib/R/etc/64/Makeconf"

and when starting R from the command line:

R> makeconf_path()
[1] "/opt/R/R-3.3.2/lib/R/etc/64/Makeconf"

May I suggest that get_make_file_text() is changed to use the same logic as makeconf_path()? 

Cheers,

Berwin
